I've examined all three conflicted files against the merge base (`d07ee59`), your side (`copilot-ide`, HEAD), and `dev` (MERGE_HEAD). Here's the full picture.

## Why these conflicts exist at all

The two branches independently added providers to the same lists:

- **`copilot-ide` (HEAD)** — commit `d8190c1` added four Copilot IDE variants (`copilotide`, `copilotide-insiders`, `copilotide-vscodium`, `copilotide-vscodium-insiders`) plus Cursor IDE coverage to the provider-command config and its tests.
- **`dev`** — commit `7b205db` added the Antigravity CLI provider (`antigravity_cmd`) to the same struct and tests, and separately reworded a resume error message.

Both sides edited the same adjacent lines, so git can't auto-merge, but the changes are almost entirely complementary — every conflict here resolves as a union of both sides, except one wording choice.

## Conflict-by-conflict observations

**1. `pkg/cmd/resume.go:359-364` — competing rewrites of the same error message.**
The merge base said: *"…can't yet be a cross-agent resume target. Choose Claude Code or Codex CLI (or resume in %s itself)."* Both branches rewrote it because hardcoding "Claude Code or Codex CLI" was stale once more resume targets existed. HEAD generalized it minimally: *"Choose a different target agent (or resume in %s itself)."* dev generalized it **and** added the reason: *"…it has no native session serializer. Choose a different target agent, or resume the session in %s itself."*
**Recommendation: take the `dev` side.** It carries strictly more information (the *why* — no native session serializer), and both sides agree on dropping the hardcoded agent names. Nothing from HEAD's version is lost.

**2. `pkg/config/config.go:252-273` — `ProvidersConfig` struct fields.**
Base had 7 fields. HEAD added the 4 `CopilotIDE*Cmd` fields; dev added `AntigravityCmd`. Neither removed anything — the apparent "missing" fields on each side are just the other branch's additions plus gofmt realignment noise.
**Recommendation: union — all 12 fields**, keeping alphabetical-ish order (Antigravity would sort first alphabetically, though dev appended it last; I'd slot `AntigravityCmd` first to match the alphabetical ordering of the rest) and let `gofmt` realign the tags. This resolution is effectively mandatory: the already-auto-merged `GetProviderCmd` at `pkg/config/config.go:975-1004` references **both** `c.Providers.AntigravityCmd` and all four Copilot fields, so anything less than the union won't compile.

**3. `pkg/config/config_test.go:~1142-1165` — `TestGetProviderCmd` fixture struct.**
Same story as #2: HEAD added the 4 Copilot entries and `CursorIDECmd: "cursor --wait"`; dev added `DeepSeekCmd: "deepseek --model r1"` and `AntigravityCmd: "agy --sandbox"`. (Base had neither CursorIDE nor DeepSeek in the fixture — each branch independently backfilled a missing one.)
**Recommendation: union — all 12 entries.**

**4. `pkg/config/config_test.go:~1173-1178` — expected test-case rows.**
HEAD added rows for the 4 `copilotide*` IDs and `{"cursoride", "cursor --wait"}`; dev added `{"deepseek", "deepseek --model r1"}`. The `antigravity` / `ANTIGRAVITY` rows from dev already auto-merged just below the conflict markers.
**Recommendation: union — keep both sides' rows.** Every row corresponds to a fixture entry from #3, so they must stay in sync.

**5. `pkg/config/config_test.go:~1306-1315` — empty-config provider ID loop.**
HEAD reformatted the ID slice to multiline and added the Copilot variants + `cursoride`; dev kept it one line and added `deepseek` + `antigravity`.
**Recommendation: union of IDs in HEAD's multiline layout** (12 IDs won't fit readably on one line): `claude`, `codex`, `copilotide`, the 3 other Copilot variants, `cursor`, `cursoride`, `deepseek`, `droid`, `gemini`, `antigravity`.

## Summary

There's really only one judgment call — **#1**, where I recommend dev's more informative wording. Conflicts #2–#5 are all straight unions, and #2 is forced by already-merged code in `GetProviderCmd`. After resolving, the plan would be `gofmt -w .`, `golangci-lint run`, and `go test ./...` (particularly `./pkg/config`) to confirm the merged test fixture and struct agree.
